node.code:
from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import MessageTextInput, StrInput, SecretStrInput, DropdownInput, IntInput, FloatInput, Output
from langflow.schema import Data
import re

class GraniteTikZGenerator(Component):
    display_name = 'IBM Granite TikZ Generator'
    description = 'Converts natural language to TikZ diagrams using IBM Granite via watsonx.ai'
    icon = 'cpu'

    inputs = [
        MessageTextInput(name='input_value', display_name='Diagram Description', required=True),
        SecretStrInput(name='api_key', display_name='IBM Cloud API Key', required=True),
        StrInput(name='project_id', display_name='Watson Studio Project ID', required=True),
        DropdownInput(name='model_id', display_name='Granite Model', options=['ibm/granite-8b-code-instruct','ibm/granite-3-1-8b-base','ibm/granite-4-h-small'], value='ibm/granite-8b-code-instruct'),
        DropdownInput(name='diagram_type', display_name='Diagram Type', options=['auto','flowchart','block diagram','tree','state machine','sequence','timeline','venn'], value='auto'),
        IntInput(name='max_tokens', display_name='Max Tokens', value=1024),
        FloatInput(name='temperature', display_name='Temperature', value=0.2),
    ]

    outputs = [Output(display_name='TikZ Code', name='tikz_code', method='generate_tikz')]

    SYSTEM_PROMPT = '''You are an expert LaTeX/TikZ diagram generator for academic research.
Convert the user description into valid compilable TikZ code.
Rules:
- Output ONLY raw TikZ code starting with \\begin{tikzpicture}
- End with \\end{tikzpicture}
- Use tikzlibrary: arrows.meta, shapes, positioning, calc
- Node names must have NO spaces
- No prose, no markdown fences, no explanations'''

    def extract_tikz(self, raw):
        matches = re.findall(r'(\\begin\{tikzpicture\}.*?\\end\{tikzpicture\})', raw, re.DOTALL)
        return matches[-1].strip() if matches else raw.strip()

    def generate_tikz(self) -> Data:
        from ibm_watsonx_ai import APIClient, Credentials
        from ibm_watsonx_ai.foundation_models import ModelInference
        from ibm_watsonx_ai.metanames import GenTextParamsMetaNames as GenParams
        credentials = Credentials(url='https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com', api_key=self.api_key)
        client = APIClient(credentials)
        model = ModelInference(
            model_id=self.model_id, api_client=client, project_id=self.project_id,
            params={GenParams.MAX_NEW_TOKENS: self.max_tokens, GenParams.TEMPERATURE: self.temperature, GenParams.DECODING_METHOD: 'greedy'}
        )
        hint = f'Create a {self.diagram_type}. ' if self.diagram_type != 'auto' else ''
        prompt = f'{self.SYSTEM_PROMPT}\nUser: {hint}{self.input_value}\nTikZ:\n\\begin{{tikzpicture}}'
        raw = model.generate_text(prompt=prompt)
        code = self.extract_tikz('\\begin{tikzpicture}' + raw)
        return Data(value=code)
